body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2010') -- <Visual News> Recom demonstrated its 'Video Name Tag' at CES 2010, allows users to control video and image content. It features replay button, play lists, reset pin.
< AVING Las Vegas team is on-site bringing readers the latest product CES2010 from the show floor, covering the press conferences >
